description: Find a paid API for any task: one search over every x402 API on Coinbase Bazaar, Circle, Fuci Market, CRA and sellers listed on APEX Market, ranked by distinct wallets that paid in 30 days (one is often the seller's own test; 3+ is where customers start), with price, chains, calls per payer and whether it answered 402 when we called it. Up to 100 results. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

chain.description: only listings payable on this chain: Base, Arc, Solana, BNB, Polygon

maxPrice.description: price cap in USD per call

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

q.description: what you need, in words, e.g. "web scrape", "token price", "weather"

name: market_search
